title: Cute but Dumb
text:
Cute but Dumb. I bought three about 8 months ago. I have hard water, and that's one of the two problems - they're impossible to clean, I even tried soaking them in citric acid solution but there's no way to get it full, unless you fill a tub with about 50 gallons of water and in California that's not an option. I might consider wasting precious water, but honestly I couldn't tell a difference in the amount of humidity anyway. The vapor seemed to go up about 8" and then drop to the floor.
So, they got me on the good reviews and the cuteness, but since then I paid $400 for one that actually works and looks even better. Dyson, if we're allowed to give other brand preferences.
